name: Clean-up Solvent

features.text: Has no adverse effect on paint when used as directed.
Dries quickly, leaving a clean surface without residue.

description: A crystal-clear solvent with a highly aromatic scent. Caution: liquid and vapor are highly flammable. Very-fast-drying solvent that leaves no residue.
application: DIRECTIONS: Wet a cloth and wipe contamination from the surface. Allow rags to completely dry before disposal to prevent spontaneous combustion. Rubber gloves should be worn. Use only in a well-ventilated area.
